About My Blog

Hi, I am Tue. The purpose of this blog is for me to write some notes as my study progresses. I hope these notes may be useful to someone who is also curious about physics and mathematics. In addition, it is also an opportunities for me to improve my writing, which is essential to my academic career. Furthermore, I sometimes write about elementary topics for a wider range of readers. As I am very sympathetic with the phrase “With great power comes great responsibility” in the the Spider-Man franchise, I believe that my “power” is my knowledge, so my “responsibility” is to share it.
